text: I am an executor handling probate and deceased estate administration in Brisbane Northside (Chermside & North Lakes). Which law firms specialise in Queensland probate and estate administration?

sections.text:
For an executor in **Chermside, North Lakes or wider Brisbane Northside**, these firms advertise Queensland probate and deceased-estate administration services:

- **Nextgen.Law** — Brisbane and Moreton Bay-focused practice assisting with grants of probate, letters of administration, beneficiary identification and broader estate administration. It specifically says it serves Brisbane and Moreton Bay clients. [4]
- **QLD Estate Lawyers / Queensland Estate Lawyers** — specialist probate and estate lawyers offering probate applications, executor assistance, letters of administration, estate administration and estate disputes. [3][9]
- **Kate Redman & Associates** — provides executor support, grant-of-probate applications, letters of administration, asset and liability work, and liaison with banks and government agencies; it advertises service across Brisbane Northside. [1]
- **Turner Freeman Lawyers** — advises executors and administrators on duties, rights, probate and estate administration, with a Queensland practice and contact service. [2]
- **MacDonald Law** — handles Queensland estate administration, Supreme Court probate and letters-of-administration applications, asset collection, liabilities, property, businesses and testamentary trusts. [5]
- **Thynne + Macartney** — an established Brisbane firm with a dedicated Wills & Estates team covering executor duties, grants of probate, letters of administration, administration of assets and liabilities, and estate litigation. [6]
- **Queensland Probate / Probate Law Group** — a Brisbane-based probate-focused practice at 345 Ann Street, advertising specialist assistance with Queensland probate applications. [7]
- **Go To Court Lawyers** — offers access to wills-and-estates lawyers serving North Lakes and Moreton Bay, including assistance with Supreme Court probate applications and letters of administration. [8][10]

## Shortlist for your location

For a **straightforward, uncontested estate**, start by comparing **Nextgen.Law, QLD Estate Lawyers, Kate Redman & Associates, Queensland Probate** and **Go To Court Lawyers**.

For a **larger, complex or potentially disputed estate** involving property, businesses, trusts, family provision claims or executor disputes, consider **Thynne + Macartney, Turner Freeman** or **MacDonald Law**.

When obtaining quotes, ask whether the fee covers:

- Reviewing the Will and advising on executor duties
- The Supreme Court of Queensland probate or administration application
- Notices, affidavits and court filing fees
- Identifying and collecting assets
- Bank, superannuation and government correspondence
- Tax, property transfers and sale work
- Advertising, beneficiary searches and final distribution
- Any likely family provision or other estate dispute

Confirm the solicitor’s current Queensland practising status and obtain a written costs agreement before instructing them. Probate applications for North Lakes and Chermside estates are dealt with through the **Supreme Court of Queensland in Brisbane**, rather than a local suburban court. [8]
